notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 Query LITS source-resignation surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies that a queued timestamped interaction keeps Query LITS defined after its producing federate resigns, while preserving standard time-management, delivery, callback, and cleanup behavior without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador Query GALT/LITS, timestamped interaction, time-management, resignation, and cleanup services with FederateAmbassador time callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador Query LITS source-resignation declarations
